newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia INCO denies share buyback plan.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia INCO denies share buyback plan.

text.p: PT International Nickel Indonesia (INCO) denied a newspaper report on Thursday that it was embarking on a share buyback plan.

"The company has never submitted a proposal for share buyback to the Capital Market Supervisory Agency (Bapepam) as they were informed...that this was contrary to Bapepam regulations," INCO said in a statement.
"The company does and will continue to operate its share dealings within Bapepam regulations," it added.
Bisnis Indonesia newspaper reported on Thursday that INCO planned to buy back 20 percent of its stock on the market.
The report prompted a wave of buying of the counter and INCO closed 700 rupiah up at 3,800, but off a midday high of 4,500.
INCO is majority owned by Canada-based Inco Ltd.
